name: maploader-slopes-spawn-chunk892
auditSeams: **Representation notes:** `SlopeLevel` holds sectors/lines/vertices for map-load slope setup; `SlopeTagManager` mirrors `FTagManager` line/sector tag hashing for `GetLineIdIterator` / sector-tag walks. `PointInSector` uses polygon winding for tests. `GetStrifeType` / `ParseUSDF` are outside this hull.
auditRationale: Faithful slope plane construction from thing specials, vertex heights, and line-ID slope lines before line-based align/copy passes.
auditManagedLocJustification: Whole-function ports for six native `MapLoader` methods (two `CopyPlane` overloads in one symbol range) on one contiguous uncredited hull.
